To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose an efficient algorithm, SOLARIA to mine hot XML query patterns and its variant SOLARIA for hot "closed" patterns.

(1) SOLARIA is the first algorithm that exploits sequence mining to accelerate hot XML pattern mining; (2) SOLARIA can be used to discover hot "closed" query patterns; (3) SOLARIA outperforms previous alternative in efficiency and scalability; and (4) SOLARIA has been successfully applied to real-life applications.
SOLARIA can efficiently mine frequent and closed hot XML query patterns in XML data repositories, with the motivation of indexing for query performance improvement.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SOLARIA is the first algorithm that can effectively discover hot query patterns in large XML repositories without candidate maintenance.
SOLARIA is the first algorithm that efficiently discovers hot XML query patterns with linear scalability in terms of XML query size.
SOLARIA is the first to provide efficient mining of hot query patterns in the context of XML query optimization.
